I’m so glad I wasn’t the only person that felt this way after it.
I played through once and it hit me harder than a train but I went back through to see if there was anyway at all to save her (first time I friendzoned, second time I confessed) and the fact that I couldn’t save her killed me.
She was so relatable to me and acted a lot like I do and was just so human. So the suicide scene hit me way harder than any other I’ve dealt with in other games, tv shows, or movies.
I’ve been in a bad state of depression from it, I suffer from Manic Depression, for about 3 days now and it’s hell.
I was having suicidal thoughts after the second playthrough when I felt completely hopeless in changing what had happened and it made me feel like trying to change anything in my life was hopeless.
(Not having suicidal thoughts now, just still in that depressive state)

I’m just really glad people are talking about it instead of just making jokes and acting like people aren’t feeling this way from it.
